purpose: Freeze the 267-Hero final composition map across frozen Hero Stage 4 and Stage 5 outputs without copying the large upstream blocks into a second monolithic dataset or reopening their semantics.

optionalParallelInputs.policy: Stage 6-1 does not block while Stage B is still producing the shared ownership relation. If the shared byHero index appears, Stage 6-1 requires exact parity with the frozen Stage 5-2 equipmentId snapshot.

output.materializationPolicy: Upstream Stage 4/5 blocks remain canonical in their frozen files. Stage 6-1 records where each Hero block lives and validates all joins instead of duplicating the blocks. A frontend/static build may materialize one Hero in memory from this index and sourceMap when needed.

sourceIndexes.normal: record index in Stage 4 combat output

normalizationPolicy.soldiers: Keep the existing Stage 5-3 byHeroId + soldiersById normalization. Stage 6-1 does not copy the 224 Soldier dictionary or 5,977 relation metadata into another structure.
normalizationPolicy.header: Stage 5-5 remains the presentation/header authority; no localization or asset path synthesis in Stage 6-1.
normalizationPolicy.exclusiveEquipment: Stage 5-2 is a frozen display snapshot while Stage B owns the final shared ownership relation.

exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.semanticOwner: shared Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment relation layer defined by Stage B
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.currentBehavior: Reference Stage 5-2 and keep only its equipmentId/status as a parity checkpoint. Do not derive ownership from ConfigData or Equipment presentation metadata.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.whenStageBArtifactMissing: Record PENDING_B_STAGE_NON_BLOCKING and allow Stage 6-1 structural completion.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.whenStageBArtifactPresent: Require exact by-Hero equipment ID parity with frozen Stage 5-2. Any mismatch is a hard error.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.finalAdmissionBoundary: Final Hero site-admission must require shared Stage B relation adoption before the whole Hero data pipeline is declared site-frozen.

forbiddenWork: Copy all Stage 4/5 payload blocks into a second monolithic Hero detail file
Recalculate Hero-exclusive Equipment ownership in Stage 6-1
Infer exclusive Equipment ownership from names, descriptions, icons, restrictions, PathType, IDs, or release order
Re-resolve Stage 5 bond or SP Mission semantics
Invent Korean localization, acquisition metadata, release dates, or asset delivery paths
hardValidationRules: Hero Stage 5 integration checkpoint must be PASS / STAGE_5_COMPLETE with zero blockers and zero hard errors
Hero master must contain exactly 267 unique heroIds
Stage 4, Stage 5-1, Stage 5-2, Stage 5-4 and Stage 5-5 must each contain exactly one record for every canonical heroId
Stage 5-3 byHeroId must contain exactly all 267 canonical Hero keys
Every Stage 5-3 soldierId must exist in Stage 5-3 soldiersById
All source index locators in the output must resolve back to the same heroId
No per-Hero Soldier membership or exclusive Equipment ownership is recalculated in Stage 6-1
If Stage B byHero exists, its Hero keys and equipment IDs must exactly match frozen Stage 5-2 ownership presence/identity
Duplicate, missing, extra or noncanonical Hero IDs are hard errors
nonBlockingInheritedReview: Stage 5-3 pending Korean Soldier display names remain presentation REVIEW only
Stage 5-5 skins with omitted GetPathType remain UNENCODED by policy
Stage 5-5 Korean localization and web-delivery asset conversion remain downstream presentation work
Stage B relation adoption is nonblocking for 6-1 only while the parallel relation stage is still in progress
completion: Stage 6-1 is COMPLETE when a lightweight 267-Hero composition index resolves every frozen Stage 4/5 block with zero structural mismatch, preserves all 5,977 Hero-Soldier edges by reference, and performs zero semantic re-derivation. Pending Stage B adoption is explicit and deferred to final Hero site-admission.
